tagline: Five in a row. Play the computer here, or a friend from one invite. No server.
description:
Five in a row. The computer thinks on this device. There is no server. Press Play a friend, send the invite, and they sit the other colour on the same board.

A wooden 15-by-15. Black and white take turns putting a stone down. First to get five in a line — across, down, or diagonal — wins. Play the computer at novice, medium, or expert, or pass the phone. Close it and come back: the file is the save.

An unofficial port of HTML5 Gomoku by yyjhao. The computer is the same one that shipped with that game.
